name: Naomi
source:
[url=/c135885]Nami[/url]'s twin sister. Her appearance and history is different in each route.

[spoiler]In the Burned Route and Fish Monster Ending, Naomi is a living human. In the former, she is delusional and living alone at the mansion, believing her mother or (non-existent) brother are still alive. In the latter, she is trying to appease the bloodthirsty [url=/c136962]Naoki[/url].
In the Mother & Father Ending and Twin's Curse Ending, she is a ghost haunting the Mansion. In the former she is trying to help her malevolent mother, while in the latter she is controlled by the [url=/c135969]Spirit of the mansion[/url] to enact the curse.
In the Shadows Ending, she was turned into the [url=/c136149]Mummy[/url] due to Nami's shadow.
In the Monster Curse Ending, she is a ghost forced to feed Naoki. In the Monster Bloodlines Ending, she is a vampire attempting to perform her [url=/c137267]father[/url]'s ceremony.
In the Fireflies Ending, she's a ghost that also transforms into the Fish Monster.
In the Epilogues, she is revealed to be just a normal human.[/spoiler]
